about: Curated starting palettes by app type. Each preset is a seed (primary hue) and an optional accent; palette.py turns them into full light + dark Material-style roles and checks WCAG AA. Run `python3 scripts/palette.py check` after editing. Pick by the feeling the product needs, then adjust the seed to the brand.

presets.name: Ledger Blue
presets.why: Deep blue reads as stable and secure; a green accent carries 'money in / positive'. Keep red strictly for losses and errors.

presets.name: Pulse Green
presets.why: Green signals health and progress; a warm orange accent gives energy to goals and streaks without alarming like red.

presets.name: Sage Calm
presets.why: Low-chroma sage lowers arousal; a muted gold accent feels warm, not loud. Prefer generous whitespace and dark mode.

presets.name: Tomato
presets.why: Red-orange stimulates appetite and urgency; amber accent for ratings and promos. Food photos carry the colour, so keep surfaces neutral.

presets.name: Shop Violet
presets.why: A saturated violet stands out on product grids without clashing with product photos; pink accent for sales and badges.

presets.name: Signal Blue
presets.why: Bright blue is neutral enough for long sessions of user content; pink for reactions and notifications.

presets.name: Focus Indigo
presets.why: Indigo feels serious and modern; amber accent marks priority and due dates. Mostly neutral UI so content leads.

presets.name: Lagoon
presets.why: Teal evokes sea and sky and stays readable on maps; a sunny accent for deals and active trips.

presets.name: Bright Learn
presets.why: Purple feels imaginative; yellow for rewards and progress. Keep text contrast high for young and new readers.

presets.name: Night Screen
presets.why: Design dark-first so artwork glows; one bold red for play and live states, violet for secondary highlights.

presets.name: Evergreen
presets.why: Deep green feels established and natural; brass accent signals premium. Large photos, quiet chrome.

presets.name: Electric Lookup
presets.why: Electric blue to violet hero with a lime accent for the one main action. High contrast for scanning results.

presets.name: Ink & Blue
presets.why: Webflow-like restraint: near-black ink, white space, one confident blue for actions. Let typography and product shots do the work.
